name: dialog-many-accounts
steps: (()=>{const name=[...document.querySelector('[role=dialog]').querySelectorAll('[title]')].find(el=>el.title.startsWith('Второй аккаунт')).querySelector('b');if(name.scrollWidth<=name.clientWidth||getComputedStyle(name).textOverflow!=='ellipsis')throw new Error('Detailed account name must truncate')})()
